name: CYPARK
recent: Cypark 完成凭单红股发行，并完成第三批也是最后一批私募配售。公司截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日止季度恢复盈利，营收大幅增长。
notable: 完成凭单红股发行，每 2 股现有普通股获 1 份凭单 A，共 452,555,088 份凭单于 2026 年 10 月 26 日上市。
完成第三批也是最后一批私募配售，7,682,700 股配售股于 2026 年 9 月 30 日上市。
截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日止季度恢复盈利，净利 RM5.696 million。
risks: 私募配售新股可能摊薄现有股东持股。
凭单红股发行若日后行使，可能进一步扩大股本。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日止季度营收 RM180.048 million，环比增长 274.2%，同比增长 332.2%；净利 RM5.696 million，净利率 3.2%，上一季度净利率为 -35.0%。

recent_en: Cypark completed its bonus issue of warrants and the third and final tranche of its private placement. The company returned to profitability in the quarter ended 31 July 2026, with revenue rising sharply.
notable_en: Completed bonus issue of warrants on the basis of 1 Warrant A for every 2 existing ordinary shares, with 452,555,088 warrants listed on 26 October 2026.
Completed the third and final tranche of its private placement, with 7,682,700 placement shares listed on 30 September 2026.
Returned to profitability in the quarter ended 31 July 2026 with a net profit of RM5.696 million.
risks_en: The private placement of new shares may dilute existing shareholders' holdings.
The bonus issue of warrants, if exercised in future, may further enlarge the share base.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue was RM180.048 million, up 274.2% QoQ and 332.2% YoY; net profit was RM5.696 million with a net margin of 3.2%, compared with a net margin of -35.0% in the previous quarter.
